youtube_description:
Gemini 3.8 Live Avatar combines live speech, generated video and background tool calls. Discover what Google announced on September 24 and how its hotel check-in demonstration illustrates an agent continuing a conversation while tools work.

This episode explains:
- What Live Avatar adds to Gemini live conversations.
- Where to start with Gemini Enterprise and the official Live API guide.
- Why custom avatars require enterprise allowlisting.

This is a source-based explanation, not our own live performance test. We have not measured avatar quality, latency or task success. Availability for your project must be checked in the official documentation.
